title: Fenton Experiment Schema Filler
description: Multi-agent Fenton mining, step 7 (split version): one instance per experiment node fills that experiment's 41 fields, the 6 stability keys, and the variable levels[] with level values, metrics, and curve bindings aligned one to one. The filler copies curve points from 04_verified_image_data.json, copies x_unit/y_unit from xy_axes, and writes a curve-binding fragment (the main agent merges it into 06; endpoint_backfill hits follow points_after). Value priority: errata, then the 5% figure-text rule, then the text, then empty. Read-only; the main agent assembles 06_schema.json.
